remarks:
Rare Opportunity to Own a Full Fractional Lockout Unit at Tamarack Club! Enjoy 52 weeks of four-season living and recreation at beautiful Tamarack Resort with Units 502 & 504. This unique lockout configuration offers flexibility for personal use, rental income, or a combination of both.

Unit 504 features a full kitchen, Murphy bed, sleeper sofa, cozy gas fireplace, and private balcony where you can take in stunning seasonal views of the surrounding hills and valley. Unit 502 offers a convenient kitchenette, queen bed, and sleeper sofa, making it ideal for guests or separate rental opportunities. Recent updates include brand-new carpeting and sleeper sofas in both units (2026).

Experience true ski-in/ski-out convenience in the winter, then relax year-round in the heated pool and hot tub. Enjoy on-site dining, unwind at the Oasis Spa, or spend your days golfing on one of the area's most scenic courses. From vibrant summer landscapes to breathtaking fall foliage painted in shades of red, orange, and gold, every season offers its own unforgettable beauty.

Tamarack Club owners enjoy easy access to the area's most popular events, including Fall Festival, Taste of Ellicottville, Rock N Roll Weekend, Summer Music Festival, Christmas in Ellicottville, Winter Blues Weekend, and Mardi Gras Weekend.

Located just one mile from the charming village of Ellicottville, you'll find an abundance of restaurants, shops, and entertainment. Hiking, skiing, High Adventure Park, the Mountain Coaster, and countless outdoor activities are all nearby.

Whether you're looking for a year-round residence, a seasonal retreat, a weekend getaway, or an investment opportunity, this property offers unmatched flexibility and endless possibilities. Come experience the Tamarack lifestyle in every season.
